nutrition.title: Nutrition & Metabolism
nutrition.subtitle: Aligning nutrient density and meal timing with digestive biology.
nutrition.trait: Innate preference for sugar and fats to survive ancestral calorie scarcity.
nutrition.trigger: Continuous access to hyper-palatable, low-fiber, ultra-processed food.

movement.title: Movement & Biomechanics
movement.subtitle: Re-introducing physical variety and persistent low-intensity locomotion.
movement.trait: Energy conservation instinct during rest; built for walking 8-12km daily.
movement.trigger: Chaired desk work, static postures, and mechanized transportation.

light.title: Light & Circadian Biology
light.subtitle: Synchronizing central suprachiasmatic nucleus (SCN) clock with solar cycles.
light.trait: Circadian entrainment driven by high-lux solar morning & dark dusk.
light.trigger: Indoor low-lux days, artificial blue-rich LED exposure after sunset.

attention.title: Attention & Social Connection
attention.subtitle: Protecting cognitive focus and tribe-scale social interaction.
attention.trait: Tuned for immediate physical environment & small tribal affinity (~150 people).
attention.trigger: Hyper-stimulating algorithmic feeds, asynchronous notifications, social isolation.

nutr_circadian.name: Circadian Fasting Window (12-14h)
nutr_circadian.mechanism: Restores hepatic clock gene expression & insular sensitivity during nocturnal phase.

nutr_wholefood.name: Whole Food Fiber-First Rule
nutr_wholefood.mechanism: Stimulates mucosal PYY & GLP-1 hormone release to signal hypothalamic satiety.

nutr_hydration.name: Pre-Meal Hydration Protocol
nutr_hydration.mechanism: Prevents osmoregulatory thirst signals from being misinterpreted as caloric hunger.

mov_microburst.name: Hourly Micro-Burst Movement
mov_microburst.mechanism: Triggers insulin-independent skeletal GLUT4 recruitment to clear plasma glucose.

mov_ground.name: Varied Posture & Floor Sitting
mov_ground.mechanism: Engages deep hip rotators & spinal stabilizer musculature, restoring pelvic motility.

mov_zone2.name: Zone-2 Aerobic Locomotion
mov_zone2.mechanism: Promotes mitochondrial density and enhances fatty-acid beta-oxidation capacity.

light_sunlight.name: Morning Outdoor Sunlight (10m)
light_sunlight.mechanism: Activates ipRGC retinal cells to reset SCN master clock & trigger cortisol peak.

light_nightshift.name: Post-Sunset Warm Light Shift
light_nightshift.mechanism: Eliminates 460nm blue spectrum to allow pineal gland uninhibited melatonin production.

light_thermal.name: Cool Room Sleep Dip (18°C/65°F)
light_thermal.mechanism: Facilitates requisite 1°C core body temperature drop for deep slow-wave sleep.

att_batching.name: Batch Notification Pulses
att_batching.mechanism: Reduces sympathetic nervous system arousal and interrupts tonic dopamine depletion.

att_focus.name: Monotropic Focus Blocks (45m)
att_focus.mechanism: Eliminates attention residue from context switching, optimizing working memory.

att_social.name: Daily In-Person Micro-Affiliation
att_social.mechanism: Triggers endogenous oxytocin synthesis and lowers amygdalar threat detection.
